description: List Business Central records of one entity (customers, vendors, items, contacts, salesQuotes, salesOrders, salesInvoices, salesCreditMemos, purchaseOrders, purchaseInvoices, employees, projects, accounts, generalLedgerEntries), newest change first. Filters: modified_since, customer_number / vendor_number (documents), and an optional OData `filter` (e.g. "status eq 'Open'", "balanceDue gt 0", "contains(displayName,'Beispiel')"). expand_lines adds the document lines. Read-only.

company.description: company name or id; default: the company set on the connection (or the only one)

customer_number.description: Only documents of this customer number

fields.description: API field names for $select, e.g. ["number","displayName","balanceDue"]; default all fields

filter.description: OData $filter (read-only). Business Central rejects "or" across different fields (HTTP 501) — use one field per call.

vendor_number.description: Only documents of this vendor number

name: list_business_central_records
